message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock data built into this chat, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York right now.  
New York is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time). If you know the current UTC time, you can subtract 4 or 5 hours to get the local time.  

For the most accurate answer, just check a world‑clock app, your phone’s clock set to “New York,” or a quick web search for “current time in New York.”
